requirement.text: The driver shall acknowledge the level transitions, if requested from trackside.

classification.rationale: The requirement describes a safety-critical train control function within the European Rail Traffic Management System (ERTMS/ETCS), which is an embedded/domain-specific railway system rather than a web application, mobile app, or AI system.

rounds.text_checked: The driver shall acknowledge the level transitions, if requested from trackside.

test_strategy.rationale: State-based testing applies because ERTMS level transitions involve distinct operational system states and state transitions triggered by trackside requests and driver actions. Decision table testing applies because combining condition inputs (trackside requests acknowledgement: yes/no; driver acknowledges: yes/no) dictates different system outcomes. Use case testing applies because acknowledging a transition is a multi-step scenario involving driver-system interaction, and this requirement has a documented dependency with PURE-ERTMS-R5.

test_cases.title: Decision Table - Trackside requests level transition acknowledgement and driver acknowledges
test_cases.preconditions: Train is operational in ERTMS Level 1 or Level 2 with trackside communication active.
steps: Send trackside command announcing level transition with driver acknowledgement requested flag set to True.
Verify DMI presents acknowledgement request to the driver.
Driver provides acknowledgement via DMI button press within the allowed time window.
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts driver acknowledgement, logs the event, and proceeds with the level transition.

test_cases.title: Decision Table - Trackside requests level transition without requiring driver acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: Train is operational with trackside communication active.
steps: Send trackside command announcing level transition with driver acknowledgement requested flag set to False.
test_cases.expected_result: System carries out the level transition automatically without displaying an acknowledgement prompt to the driver or requiring driver action.

test_cases.title: State Based - Transition from Pending Driver Ack to Level Ack Confirmed state
test_cases.preconditions: Train onboard system is in 'Level Transition Pending Ack' state following trackside signal.
steps: Verify system state is currently 'Level Transition Pending Ack'.
Driver inputs acknowledgement command on the DMI before timer expiry.
test_cases.expected_result: System state changes from 'Level Transition Pending Ack' to 'Level Transition Confirmed' and transitions to the new ERTMS level.

test_cases.title: Use Case - Complete level transition workflow with driver acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: Train is approaching a trackside border requiring transition from Level 1 to Level 2 requiring driver acknowledgement.
steps: Trackside transmits transition order requiring driver confirmation.
System alerts driver via visual indicator and acoustic signal on DMI.
Driver acknowledges the transition notification within the required timeframe.
test_cases.expected_result: System successfully transitions to Level 2 without triggering brake intervention from requirement PURE-ERTMS-R5.

final_text: The driver shall acknowledge the level transitions, if requested from trackside.
